canonical_name: Jawcraig grid connection (potential data centre site)
summary: A 180MW gate 2 grid connection reported by APRS (citing NESO's Existing Agreements Register) for 'Jawcraig, Falkirk' — Jawcraig is a small farming settlement about 2 miles north of Slamannan on the Slamannan Plateau, Falkirk Council area, with a history of colliery, opencast fireclay and brickworks land. No planning application, developer announcement or press coverage has been found; the site exists in the public record only as a grid connection agreement. No developer has been identified.
maturity_explanation: Only evidence is a reported 180MW gate 2 grid connection in NESO's Existing Agreements Register as relayed by APRS (page updated July 2026). PlanIt searches 2019-2026 for 'Jawcraig' (all authorities) and Falkirk + 'data centre' found no Jawcraig record (the only Falkirk data centre application is the separate Larbert/Glenbervie project); no developer or press attribution found.

latest_development.headline: APRS data centre map (updated 29 July 2026) lists Jawcraig, Falkirk 180MW among five gate 2 connection sites 'not otherwise seen elsewhere'

unknowns: The NESO register row (connectee, connection site, dates) has not been independently extracted; the 180MW figure rests on APRS's reading.
Exact location: 'Jawcraig' comprises Easter Jawcraig, Jawcraig and Wester Jawcraig farms; which land is involved is unknown, and coordinates are estimated from the Gazetteer description only.
No developer or connectee identified by any source.
Whether the end use is a data centre rather than another demand user or storage (the Slamannan Plateau hosts wind farms and BESS activity).
No planning activity of any kind was found.
Whether this connection is related to the separate Apatura Larbert/Glenbervie 300MW application elsewhere in Falkirk is unknown; no source links them.
